opportunities.title: Main Grants (Research, Development and Analysis Fund)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to UK‑based organisations and institutions; applicants must have a formal employment or contractual relationship with a UK host institution. Excludes individuals without such affiliation, schools, further education colleges, undergraduates, master’s students, PhD fees, establishment of academic posts, and projects led by organisations not based in the UK (except exceptional overseas cases).
opportunities.summary: Funding for research projects that address one or more of the Foundation’s five priority questions, with up to £500,000 (or up to £750,000 in special cases) per grant.

opportunities.title: Racial Diversity UK Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to individuals and organisations, especially from racially minoritised communities, and encourages partnership applications with racially minoritised communities. Applicants should be based in the UK.
opportunities.summary: Supports research on racial diversity within the UK, with grants ranging from £15,000 to £500,000, focusing on inter‑generational changes and challenges in a racially diverse society.
